articles.title: New Hunger Games Movie Keeps a Secret About Haymitch and Maysilee
articles.summary: Director Francis Lawrence says he and stars Joseph Zada and McKenna Grace kept private ideas about Haymitch and Maysilee's bond ahead of the November 20, 2026 film.

articles.title: Jay-Z Will Finally Sing at the Super Bowl Halftime Show
articles.summary: The NFL announced Jay-Z will headline the Super Bowl LXI halftime show on February 14 near Los Angeles, his first time performing at the big game.

articles.title: Cade Mower Wins His Battle on The Voice and Moves On
articles.summary: Cade Mower beat Brayden Howell in The Voice Battle round on October 26 and moves into Cut Week as one of seven singers left on Team Riley.
